findings.problem: Current checkout HEAD can identify a different revision from the compiled code launched or installed. The launcher prefers an existing dist entry and install copies dist without rebuilding.
findings.impact: A build made at revision A can be launched or installed after checkout advances to B and be incorrectly described as running B.
findings.recommendedMinimalAdjustment: Explicitly require a fresh build from the captured checkout before compiled launch/install and document stale dist as an additional identity limitation. Describe the field as captured source provenance under that prerequisite; do not promise executable verification or introduce a build pipeline.

findings.problem: Explicit Git cwd alone does not guarantee C2C revision origin. The plan does not specify inherited Git override sanitization or rejection of unrelated enclosing repositories.
findings.impact: Revision discovery can succeed with an unrelated repository HEAD instead of returning null.
findings.recommendedMinimalAdjustment: Use the existing repository-location environment sanitization behavior, verify the discovered repository belongs to the C2C app root, and return null when that origin cannot be established. Add inherited-override and nested non-checkout fixtures, retaining linked-worktree support.

findings.problem: The smoke procedure names the test-profile restart but does not state that install replaces the shared application and launchers and refreshes the global skill.
findings.recommendedMinimalAdjustment: Document the shared install side effects, select the intended C2C_HOME explicitly, and use the installed c2ct entry point for test-profile lifecycle operations. Preserve a way to reinstall the previous app if smoke verification fails.

validation.nonCheckoutAppInsideUnrelatedRepository: passed reproduction: enclosing repository HEAD returned
validation.probeIsolation: temporary directories outside repository, automatically removed

implementationGuidance.recommendation: Place revision resolution/persistence in a focused module; keep the CLI install hook small. No broad installer refactor is required.

scope: Only this review evidence file was added; plan and implementation unchanged.
